exposure: Bundle components (pre- and postsurgical education and access to follow-up, peri- and intraoperative practice changes, risk stratification tool for postoperative dressing selection)
outcome: Surgical site infections (SSI) following Cesarean delivery
cohort: Patients undergoing Cesarean delivery at a specific hospital.
finding: The implementation of an interdisciplinary bundle and standardized processes led to a significant 75% reduction in surgical site infections following cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The quality improvement project successfully reduced surgical site infections specifically for patients undergoing cesarean delivery.
followup_time: Rates of surgical site infections were monitored over a 25-month period following the intervention's initiation (April 2022 to May 2024).
